title: Python SCHC FragmentSender accepts empty packet that cannot be serialized
description: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py deliberately builds one All-1 fragment for an empty payload, but Fragment.to_bytes requires the All-1 final tile to contain 1..187 bytes. FragmentSender(b"") therefore constructs successfully and then fails when start() serializes it. The fixed profile and shared malformed vector require a non-empty final tile, and Rust rejects an empty packet at sender construction, so Python also diverges cross-implementation.
acceptance_criteria: FragmentSender rejects an empty payload during construction with FragmentError before allocating/building fragments, unless the protocol is explicitly changed everywhere to define an empty-packet encoding. Remove the incorrect empty-datagram comment/path. Add focused tests proving empty construction fails deterministically, no sender state is started, and Python behavior matches Rust and the shared non-empty-final-tile vector. Non-empty one-byte and maximum-size packets continue to serialize and round-trip.
